P3: panel/frontend/src/pages/plugins/PluginDetailPage.vue:301 | root cause: DeleteConfirmDialog hardcodes the warning 此操作不可撤销，请谨慎操作, but page-detail now reuses it for the reversible disable and rollback actions, so the warning is factually inaccurate for those flows. | refs: DeleteConfirmDialog.vue:42 hardcodes the string; confirmCopy adds disable/rollback cases but does not override the warning. | impact: users see an irreversible warning for reversible operations, reducing warning credibility and potentially causing confusion. | minimal fix: make the warning text a configurable prop on DeleteConfirmDialog (or use a generic ConfirmDialog) and pass accurate per-action warning copy.
